Builds & Threads Things I’ve Made And Books I’ve Read

Written by: Rajat Khirid

Hey, I’m Rajat. Welcome to my corner of the web. By day, I’m a Cloud and DevOps engineer in Pune scaling production systems on AWS and Kubernetes—taking messy infrastructure and making it reproducible, observable, and quiet. By night, I’m usually reading, riding my motorbike down the coast, or tinkering on the bare-metal homelab serving you this page.

Feel free to poke around the things I’ve built, read the threads I’ve written, browse the books on my nightstand, read a little more about me, or send me an email. I’m glad you’re here.
